per_finding.note: R-001 explicitly identifies a utility voltage sag causing chillers to fail to restart automatically.
The triage does not mention incremental load increases or a timing defect in the Chiller Management System.
The triage does not address high chilled water loop temperatures preventing restart of the final chillers.
The triage does not mention a self-protection mechanism inhibiting restart due to elevated water temperatures.
R-002 directs acting before automated shutdowns begin, but does not specify the 11:34 UTC remote shutdown of remaining infrastructure.
The triage does not state that shutdown would allow the chilled water loop to cool and enable chiller restart.
The triage does not mention implementing a control timing logic change to the Chiller Management System.
The triage does not mention changing the Emergency Operation Procedure to a load-based restart sequence.
The triage does not mention increasing technician staffing levels as a temporary mitigation.
The triage does not discuss staffing levels or a load-based restart sequence preventing impact.
R-002 explicitly expects automated device shutdowns once the thermal buffer is depleted.
